title: Pilot memory note
description: One memory note (C9): a Markdown file named <id>.md whose first lines are a fixed-key front-matter block, followed by the note body. Frozen so store writes and parses stay deterministic and gate-testable.

id.description: Slug identifier; must match the filename without .md.

tags.description: Comma-separated in the file; a list after parsing.

noteFile.description: Textual file shape: `---`, five `key: value` lines (tags comma-separated), `---`, blank line, Markdown body.

embeddingIndex.description: The derived embedding index (C9), at <memory_dir>/index.json. Never a source of truth: rebuildable from the notes, deterministic under a pinned embedder.

model.description: Embedder identity that produced the vectors; a change invalidates the index.

hash.description: Deterministic digest of (note ids + updated timestamps), so staleness is detectable.

searchHit.description: One memory search result (C9): hybrid score and why it matched.
